cpu.desc: CPU allocation in threads. 100% = 1 thread, 200% = 2 threads

disk.desc: Disk space allocation in MB (4096 MB = 4 GB)

memory.desc: How much memory in MB to allocate

ip.desc: What IP to bind the server to

worldname.desc: World to load. A new world with this name is created if it does not exist

serverpassword.desc: Password players need to join. Empty means anyone can join. No commas

motd.desc: Message shown to players when they join. No double quotes

commands: bash -c "for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do steamcmd +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux +force_install_dir /SkyPanel +login anonymous +app_update 1169370 validate +quit && exit 0; echo 'steamcmd could not finish the download, trying again in 15s ($try/5)'; sleep 15; done; exit 1"

bash -c "mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64; for d in .steam .steam/steamcmd .local/share/Steam/steamcmd steamcmd; do if [ -f $d/linux32/steamclient.so ]; then cp -f $d/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/; fi; if [ -f $d/linux64/steamclient.so ]; then cp -f $d/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/; fi; done; true"

install.text:
SERVER = {
	port = ${port}, 				// [0 - 65535] Server default port
	slots = ${maxplayers}, 				// [1 - 250] Server default slots
	password = ${serverpassword}, 				// Leave blank for no password
	pauseWhenEmpty = true,
	giveClientsPower = true,	// If true, clients will have much more power over what hits them, their position etc
	logging = true, 			// If true, will create log files for each server start
	language = en,
	zipSaves = true, 			// If true, will create new saves in a zipfile
	MOTD = "${motd}",			// Message of the day
}
